scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:generate && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --names web,api --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @mini-otl/web dev" "pnpm --filter @mini-otl/api dev"
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @mini-otl/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @mini-otl/api exec prisma migrate dev
